primary_claim: Under defined degraded-connectivity conditions, twin-informed service-aware orchestration reduces total service outage time relative to static, network-only, and service-priority policies while respecting energy, fairness, privacy, and reliability constraints.

primary.name: total_service_outage_time_s
primary.description: Total duration during which the service is classified unavailable within the session

secondary.name: time_to_recovery_s
secondary.do_not: treat censored events as observed completed recoveries

definition.unavailable_rule: service_available==false OR probe_timeout OR latency_ms is null
definition.probe_cadence: reported from sample timestamp deltas; missing gaps flagged when >2.5× median
definition.interval_censoring_uncertainty: half median probe interval observation bound
definition.multiple_outages: sum durations for primary; per-event secondary list
definition.false_timeout_flags: probe_timeout forces unavailable even if latency present; documented risk

rationale: Amendment 001: summing unavailable intervals is total outage duration, not a single recovery-time estimand. Primary is therefore total_service_outage_time_s. Event-level time_to_recovery_s remains secondary with explicit right-censoring.
amendment_policy: Preserve originals under evaluation/amendments/; never silently rewrite history.
